about.title: Professional Profile
about.description: I build production web and cross-platform systems from architecture through deployment and operations. My core is TypeScript: Next.js and React applications, Bun and Node.js backends, PostgreSQL data layers, and Turborepo monorepos. I also design AI-enabled workflows with MCP, local LLMs and n8n, using Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Gemini CLI and Crush in hands-on development. Beyond the web stack I administer Linux infrastructure — Proxmox VE virtualization, virtual machines, SSH and application deployment. Currently expanding into embedded development with ESP32, targeting robotics, UAVs and automated production lines. I focus on maintainable domain models, security and measurable product outcomes.
